title: Studio Tips
content: A couple of GurneyJourney blog readers shared some helpful studio tips:Doug Goodalesays: "I recently built a lightweight sketch easelaccording to your specsand added some Velcro strips so it could hold a 1/4 sheet of watercolour paper. I had a plastic palette, so glued some rare earth magnets on the mixing surface to affix it to the easel."Lawrence Roibalsays: "Having had the privilege of being in the presence of the greatSteve Assaelpainting from life, I witnessed how he utilizes the theory of theparallel palettewithout the expense. He would just fashion a makeshift palette right on his painting surface or utilize a clamp, and a simple masonite palette."----Thanks, Doug and Larry
